Create a wide 9-panel cinematic storyboard infographic for a tragic apocalyptic romance short film set during the end of the world on a collapsing mountain cliff above a destroyed city.

The story follows a young couple in their 20s during their final moments together as earthquakes split the earth apart, massive tidal waves rise in the distance, violent lightning storms fill the daytime sky, and the mountain beneath them begins collapsing.

The emotional climax:

the girl says: “Let me go…”

the boy, crying while holding her tightly, says: “I love you.”

he finally releases her hand with tears

she falls from the collapsing mountain into the abyss below

The storyboard must feel like a real Hollywood disaster romance film pitch deck with a clear emotional story arc ending in sacrifice and heartbreak.

STYLE & CINEMATOGRAPHY

Ultra-realistic cinematic photography
ARRI Alexa 35mm anamorphic lens
Shallow depth of field
Dramatic volumetric lighting
Daytime apocalypse atmosphere
Dark storm clouds with powerful lightning bolts
Cool blue-teal tones mixed with warm orange firelight
Lens flares, rain mist, smoke, ash particles
Epic cinematic scale
Photorealistic emotional acting
Moody, heartbreaking romance

CHARACTER DESIGN

Ethan (24)

Protective, emotional, broken

Wet messy dark hair

Dark rugged jacket

Bruised face covered in rain and ash

Crying while trying not to lose her

Maya (22)

Brave, loving, selfless

Long dark wet hair blowing violently in storm winds

Oversized dark coat

Emotional tear-filled eyes

Calm acceptance despite fear

STORYBOARD PANELS

PANEL 1 — “THE LAST DAY”

Wide daytime establishing shot of a destroyed world. Giant lightning strikes across dark storm clouds. Massive cracks split the city below while fire and smoke rise everywhere. Ethan and Maya stand on the edge of a collapsing mountain.

PANEL 2 — “STAY WITH ME”

The couple embraces desperately as earthquake tremors shake the mountain. Dust and debris fall around them. Emotional close body language.

PANEL 3 — “NO ESCAPE”

A colossal tidal wave rises behind the ruined skyline far below. Lightning illuminates the wave. The mountain cliff begins breaking apart under their feet.

PANEL 4 — “HOLDING ON”

Close-up of Ethan gripping Maya tightly with tears streaming down his face. Rain and ash cover their skin. Intense emotional realism.

PANEL 5 — “LET ME GO”

Maya gently places her hand on Ethan’s face and softly says:
“Let me go…”
She realizes the cliff cannot hold both of them.

PANEL 6 — “I LOVE YOU”

Ethan breaks emotionally, crying as he whispers:
“I love you.”
He refuses to release her hand while the ground collapses further around them.

PANEL 7 — “THE RELEASE”

Slow-motion cinematic shot. Ethan finally releases her trembling hand with tears in his eyes. Maya falls backward from the collapsing mountain cliff.

PANEL 8 — “THE FALL”

Epic wide shot of Maya falling into the storm-filled abyss below while lightning tears across the sky and debris collapses around her. Ethan screams helplessly at the edge of the cliff.

PANEL 9 — “AFTERMATH”

Ethan collapses to his knees alone on the ruined mountain edge. Rain pours down. Fires burn in the distance. Smoke and lightning fill the sky while tears stream down his devastated face.
